title.en: The One With the Perfume Launch

description.es: Se lanza el nuevo perfume. Marta se disculpa con Fina una vez más, y las dos hablan de su pasado y de su vida personal. Marta deja caer la carta que piensa enviarle a Jaime y, mientras Fina se la devuelve, Marta le roza la mano.
description.en: The new perfume is launched. Marta apologizes to Fina once again, and the two of them talk about their pasts and personal lives. Marta drops the letter she intends to send to Jaime, and as Fina hands it back to her, Marta touches Fina's hand.
